incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — P1 embeddings-eu1 high error rate (500s) — incident created 3790001234
Maya Patel: on it, looking at spikes in mux and 503s
Maya Patel: running `kubectl -n inference get pods | grep embeddings` to check pod restarts
Maya Patel: initial mitigation: scaled replicas + set `MAX_BATCH_MS=5` on canary pool
Maya Patel: Diffs: errors down 30% over 4m but latency up; still customer-impacting
Liam Chen: I'm coming on shift in ~8m, can I take driver? worrying about APAC coverage though
Maya Patel: yes please take driver @Liam Chen — I'll keep comms until handoff. Need comms owner too.
Nora Blake: I can take comms for the handoff and own external updates for next 30m
Ravi Kapoor: flagging legal — there was an affected contract; please cc legal if we confirm customer data access
Maya Patel: good call. No evidence of data exfil yet. @legal-team please standby. link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-throttle
Maya Patel: Runbook excerpt:
```
1) Check pod restarts: kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide
2) Tail unhappy container logs: kubectl logs -n inference <pod> -c model | tail -n 200
3) Scale canary: kubectl scale deploy embeddings-canary --replicas=6
4) Set MAX_BATCH_MS env and rollout: kubectl set env deploy/embeddings-canary MAX_BATCH_MS=5
```
Liam Chen: copy. I'll be primary driver at 3790001280. Nora, you're comms owner after Maya passes off.
Maya Patel: handing off driver -> @Liam Chen at 3790001280. I'll post final notes before stepping out.
Maya Patel: note: we've opened temporary circuit breaker on low-priority tenants to reduce tail latency
Nora Blake: I'll post status update to #incidents and DM account team. Drafting now.
Nora Blake: Posting: `P1: embeddings-eu1 - mitigations in progress. Driver: Liam Chen. Comms: Nora Blake. No customer-visible data exposure suspected.`
Ravi Kapoor: please add "Escalate to SRE if error rate > 40% for 3 consecutive 5m windows"
Liam Chen: ack. I'll monitor metrics and adjust batching/replicas. If errors rebound, I'll trigger full rollback to previous model
Maya Patel: last thing — update incident tracker (link: https://redwood.internal/inc/3790001234) with handoff notes
Liam Chen: updated tracker and set pager priority to "driver" for me. handing over in 10s :thumbsup:
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Ownership change recorded — driver=Liam Chen, comms=Nora Blake, timestamp=3790001290
Nora Blake: confirmed. thanks Maya — take rest, I'll ping if anything spikes :coffee:
Maya Patel: thanks team, keeping an eye for 5 more mins then off. Good handoff.
